description: Final six-panel provenance figure summarising every executed analysis
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
geo=pd.read_csv("superposed_ligand_distances.csv"); dnds=pd.read_csv("dnds_nei_gojobori.csv")
ident=pd.read_csv("ortholog_identity.csv"); hs=pd.read_csv("human_specific_sub_distances.csv")
rows=["DVD Asp1 (Mn ligand)","DVD Asp2 (Mn ligand)","Lys359 equiv","Arg365 equiv","catalytic Glu"]
lab=["D199\nDVD1","D201\nDVD2","K333","R339","E291\ncat."]
g=geo.set_index("role").loc[rows]; x=np.arange(5); w=0.27
cols3=["#1a7f5a","#2d6cdf","#d1495b"]; labs3=["bovine 1O7Q","human AF","rat AF"]

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(15,9)); gs=fig.add_gridspec(2,3,hspace=0.62,wspace=0.34)
for j,(pre,yl,hl,ti) in enumerate([("Mn","distance to Mn2+ (A)",2.5,"A  Metal site after superposition\n285 CA pairs, 1.38 A RMSD"),
                                   ("UDP","distance to UDP (A)",4.0,"B  Donor site, same superposition\nUDP A/1374, 2.11 A from Mn")]):
    ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,j])
    for k,sfx in enumerate(["bov","human","rat"]):
        ax.bar(x+(k-1)*w,g[f"{pre}:{sfx}"].values,w,color=cols3[k],label=labs3[k])
    ax.axhline(hl,ls="--",c="k",lw=.9); ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(lab,fontsize=8)
    ax.set_ylabel(yl); ax.set_title(ti,fontsize=10,loc="left")
    if j==0: ax.legend(fontsize=7)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,2]); d=hs.sort_values("d_UDP_A")
cc=["#2d6cdf" if any(t in s for t in ["DVD","catalytic","donor His"]) else "#d1495b" for s in d.site]
ax.barh(range(len(d)),d.d_UDP_A,color=cc); ax.set_yticks(range(len(d)))
ax.set_yticklabels([s.split(" (")[0] for s in d.site],fontsize=8)
ax.axvline(4.0,ls="--",c="k",lw=.9); ax.set_xlabel("distance to UDP (A)")
ax.set_title("C  Catalytic residues (blue) vs human and\nhominid-specific changes (red)",fontsize=10,loc="left")

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0])
ax.barh(range(len(dnds)),dnds.omega,color=["#2d6cdf" if q=="A3GALT2" else "#aaaaaa" for q in dnds.gene])
ax.set_yticks(range(len(dnds))); ax.set_yticklabels(dnds.gene+" "+dnds.pair,fontsize=6)
ax.axvline(1.0,ls="--",c="r",lw=.9); ax.set_xlabel("dN/dS (Nei-Gojobori)")
ax.set_title("D  Selection: A3GALT2 blue, A4GALT control grey",fontsize=10,loc="left")

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1]); i=ident.sort_values("pct_id")
ax.barh(range(len(i)),i.pct_id,color="#1a7f5a"); ax.set_yticks(range(len(i)))
ax.set_yticklabels([o.replace("A3GALT2_","") for o in i.ortholog],fontsize=7)
ax.set_xlabel("% identity to human A3GALT2"); ax.set_xlim(60,100)
ax.set_title("E  Ortholog panel used for the residue audit",fontsize=10,loc="left")

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,2]); ax.axis("off")
ax.text(0,1,("F  Pseudogenisation tests, all negative\n\n"
 "reading frame  1023 nt, 341 codons, ATG..TAG,\n               0 internal stop codons\n"
 "splice sites   4/4 introns canonical GT..AG\n               (ENST00000442999, GRCh38)\n"
 "residue audit  14/16 GT6 functional positions\n               identical in human and all 11\n"
 "               orthologs. One more differs only\n"
 "               by a marmoset-specific Ile, so\n"
 "               human departs from the mammalian\n"
 "               consensus at exactly ONE site\n"
 "that site      E->G at 334, shared with chimp;\n               ABO carries Asn and GBGT1 Asp\n               at the same aligned position\n"
 "selection      no human-lineage relaxation\n               (0.41 vs 0.40 macaque-marmoset)\n"
 "signal anchor  type II TM 13-32 intact\n\n"
 "Counterweight, within humans:\n"
 "gnomAD LOEUF 1.32, pLI 0.00006,\n14 obs vs 16.6 exp pLoF, missense Z -2.10"),
 va="top",family="monospace",fontsize=8.3)
fig.suptitle("Human A3GALT2 (U3KPV4): the GT6 catalytic apparatus is intact and geometrically assembled, while constraint within humans is absent",fontsize=13,y=0.985)
plt.show()
print("evidence_matrix.csv and GO_decision_table.csv written")
